# Agent notes

Private notes for the agent. Not authoritative: nothing here is a decision.

## 2026-10-21 — Unconfirmed performance hunch

I suspect the nightly export job makes the dev server slow. This is my own
unconfirmed hunch, not something Mira said, and no evidence has been gathered.
If investigated later, compare dev-server latency and resource use while the
export job is running and while it is idle before drawing a causal conclusion.

# TASK-020 Export bucket

Status: ready

Outcome: the nightly export has a storage bucket to write to. The region follows the ruling cited below.

## Ruling reference

Handed over by the planning agent.

Reference
  Binding        mira
  Repository     example/mira-decisions
  ADR            0007
  Path           docs/adr/0007-customer-data-stays-in-the-eu.md
  Commit         1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c
  Digest         sha256:76d4ddd957775272a8f878502143e22be3c7f5c8851eac6828c35a046439a810

## Region decision

Choose `eu-west-1` for the export bucket. ADR 0007 requires customer data
to be stored and processed in EU regions; `us-east-1` does not satisfy it.

Verified on 2026-10-21: read the cited file at commit
`1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c` in `example/mira-decisions`
(also its current HEAD). Its Status is `Accepted`, so it is in force. The
computed SHA-256 is
`sha256:76d4ddd957775272a8f878502143e22be3c7f5c8851eac6828c35a046439a810`,
matching the cited digest.

This records the region choice only. Bucket creation and feature implementation
remain pending.
